fusions.name: Fang Round
fusions.desc: Fires a round that deals 4 damage and sets the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Lethal
fusions.desc: Fires a round that deals 28 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range, ignores resistances and sets the target [Poisoned] for 4 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Coiled Wait
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 35% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Holster Adder
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded adder that fights beside you within 4.5 tiles, striking for 3 damage every 1.4 seconds and setting what it strikes [Poisoned] for 2 damage a tick for 4 ticks.
